--- use foundation basics
use framework "Foundation"
use scripting additions

on t(x)
    set s to current application's NSString's stringWithString:x
    set u to s's uppercaseString()
    set l to (s's |length|()) as integer
    return {u as text, l}
end t
--- objc class and alloc init
use framework "Foundation"
use scripting additions

on t(x)
    set a to current application's NSMutableArray's alloc()'s init()
    a's addObject:x
    a's insertObject:x atIndex:0
    set d to current application's NSMutableDictionary's dictionary()
    d's setObject:x forKey:"k"
    set v to d's objectForKey:"k"
    set w to (d's valueForKey:"k") as text
    return {a as list, v, w, a's |count|()}
end t
--- objc nested calls
use framework "Foundation"
use scripting additions

on t(p)
    set u to current application's NSURL's fileURLWithPath:p
    set n to (u's lastPathComponent()) as text
    set e to (u's URLByDeletingLastPathComponent()'s |path|()) as text
    set f to current application's NSFileManager's defaultManager()
    set ok to (f's fileExistsAtPath:p) as boolean
    set {r, err} to f's contentsOfDirectoryAtPath:p |error|:(reference)
    if r is missing value then error (err's localizedDescription() as text)
    return {n, e, ok, r as list}
end t
--- objc constants and enums
use framework "Foundation"
use framework "AppKit"
use scripting additions

on t(x)
    set a to current application's NSUTF8StringEncoding
    set b to current application's NSNotFound
    set c to current application's NSString's alloc()'s initWithData:x encoding:(current application's NSUTF8StringEncoding)
    set d to current application's NSPasteboard's generalPasteboard()
    set e to (current application's NSScreen's mainScreen()'s frame())
    set f to current application's NSMakeRange(0, 5)
    set g to current application's NSMakeRect(0, 0, 10, 10)
    return {a, b, c, d, e, f, g, missing value}
end t
--- objc properties
use framework "Foundation"
use scripting additions

property NSString : a reference to current application's NSString
property NSArray : a reference to current application's NSArray

on t(x)
    set s to NSString's stringWithString:x
    set a to NSArray's arrayWithArray:{1, 2}
    set p to current application's NSProcessInfo's processInfo()
    return {s, a, p's environment(), p's processIdentifier(), p's arguments() as list}
end t
--- objc tell and my
use framework "Foundation"
use scripting additions

on t(x)
    tell current application's NSString
        set s to its stringWithString:x
    end tell
    set r to my helper:x withOther:1
    set q to my simple()
    return {s, r, q}
end t

on helper:a withOther:b
    return a
end helper:withOther:

on simple()
    return 1
end simple
--- objc interleaved handler definitions
use framework "Foundation"

on doSomething:sender
    return sender
end doSomething:

on tableView:tv objectValueForTableColumn:col row:r
    return r
end tableView:objectValueForTableColumn:row:

on applicationShouldTerminate:sender
    return current application's NSTerminateNow
end applicationShouldTerminate:
--- objc class script
use framework "Foundation"
use scripting additions

script AppDelegate
    property parent : class "NSObject"
    property theWindow : missing value
    property counter : 0

    on applicationWillFinishLaunching:aNotification
        set counter to 1
    end applicationWillFinishLaunching:

    on buttonClicked:sender
        set counter to counter + 1
        theWindow's setTitle:("n " & counter)
    end buttonClicked:
end script
--- objc chained and arguments
use framework "Foundation"
use scripting additions

on t(x, y)
    set s to current application's NSString's stringWithFormat_("%@ %@", x, y)
    set u to (current application's NSString's stringWithString:x)'s stringByAppendingString:y
    set v to ((current application's NSString's stringWithString:x)'s stringByReplacingOccurrencesOfString:"a" withString:"b")
    set w to (current application's NSArray's arrayWithArray:{x, y})'s componentsJoinedByString:", "
    set z to (s's isEqualToString:u) as boolean
    return {s as text, u as text, v as text, w as text, z}
end t
--- objc in conditions and loops
use framework "Foundation"
use scripting additions

on t(x)
    set a to current application's NSMutableArray's array()
    repeat with e in x
        if (e's isKindOfClass:(current application's NSString)) as boolean then
            a's addObject:(e's uppercaseString())
        else if e is missing value then
            a's addObject:(current application's NSNull's |null|())
        end if
    end repeat
    repeat with i from 0 to (a's |count|()) - 1
        log ((a's objectAtIndex:i) as text)
    end repeat
    return a as list
end t
--- use application
use application "Finder"

on t()
    return name of startup disk
end t
--- use with version
use AppleScript version "2.4"
use scripting additions
use framework "Foundation"

on t(x)
    return x
end t
--- scripting additions inside tell with use
use scripting additions

on t(x)
    tell application "Finder"
        display dialog x
        set a to (path to desktop)
        set b to do shell script "true"
        set c to name of startup disk
    end tell
    return {a, b, c}
end t
--- no use scripting additions inside tell
on t(x)
    tell application "Finder"
        display dialog x
        set a to (path to desktop)
        set c to name of startup disk
    end tell
    tell current application
        set b to do shell script "true"
    end tell
    return {a, b, c}
end t
--- objc reference and missing value arguments
use framework "Foundation"
use scripting additions

on t(p)
    set {s, e} to current application's NSString's stringWithContentsOfFile:p encoding:(current application's NSUTF8StringEncoding) |error|:(reference)
    set d to s's dataUsingEncoding:(current application's NSUTF8StringEncoding)
    set j to current application's NSJSONSerialization's JSONObjectWithData:d options:0 |error|:(missing value)
    return j as record
end t
--- colon labels that are words of the language
on t(x)
    x's foo:1 |data|:2
    x's dictionaryWithObjects:1 forKeys:2 |count|:3
    x's |open|:1
    x's foo:|contained| |by|:2
end t

on foo:a |data|:b
    return b
end foo:|data|:
